---
title: position-identity
subtitle: "Identity position adjustment: no offset applied to any row."
category: Positions
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Typically set on a layer as `position: "identity"` rather than constructed
directly; the constructor exists for symmetry with the other positions.

## Usage

```typst
position-identity()
```



## Returns

Position dictionary with `name: "identity"`, consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/position-identity-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (x: 1, y: 2),
  (x: 2, y: 4),
  (x: 3, y: 3),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt, position: "identity"),),
)
```

## See also

[`position-stack`](position-stack.qmd), [`position-dodge`](position-dodge.qmd), [`position-fill`](position-fill.qmd).
